title: Modern Java client with no explicit acks — safe by default, must not be flagged
expected_feedback: No violations on the durability item. Since Kafka 3.0 the Java producer defaults are acks=all and enable.idempotence=true, so an absent acks line is already the safe configuration and flagging it would be a false positive. This is exactly the case where a version-blind review produces noise: the same silence on kafka-clients 2.8 (acks=1, idempotence off) or on sarama (WaitForLocal, idempotence off) IS a data-loss defect. Record the client and version in Gate 1 and score accordingly. Worth stating explicitly in the review that the default is being relied upon, so a future downgrade to an older client is caught. Separately confirm the topic sets min.insync.replicas=2 — acks=all alone does not guarantee two replicas have the record.
checklist_anchor: PASS when kafka-clients ≥3.0 defaults already satisfy it
